title: Necromancer: new undead
description: New undead for the Necromancer mod, made with Meshy: a Lich (a robed sorcerer that casts bolts, on the game's skeleton mage) and a Bone Golem (a 3 m brute of fused bones, on the game's Vukah elite). Raise them with the Necromancer's wheel or /necromancer raise lich | golem.
notes: The sources are not in the repository: the Meshy glbs and textures, the fitted glbs, the game dumps; the paths below point to a local folder. Build: python -I tools/models/make_mod.py tools/models/packs/necromancer_undead.json
The GUIDs are fixed forever: mods/necromancer/minions.lua and players' saves refer to them.

Lich: Meshy preview 01a17d27-93bc-71d6-9384-47273a6382b8, refine 01a17d29-80c9-7359-9b8b-8f5b481bce0a; fitted with blender/fit_humanoid.py --keep-uvs --skirt 0.06 onto char_enemy_skeleton_mage_01 (its robe below the knees follows the thighs) (skeleton 5a4d9d98); a copy of Enemy_Skeleton_Mage01 with DamageMod_Multiplier x1.3 (health x1.5 comes from Necromancer at runtime).

Bone Golem: Meshy preview 01a17d4a-d5ab-73b2-8fde-5eda7bccb1b4, refine 01a17d4c-6e3e-743a-bd7a-a2aae07fc22a; albedo lightened (texture_mips.py --tint 1.85,1.85,1.9 --add 0.03,0.03,0.04); fitted with blender/fit_humanoid.py --keep-uvs --material 1 --height-scale 0.95 onto char_enemy_vukah_elite_01 (main chains only: no helper bones) (the Vukah elite: hunched, long arms, fists; body material 1); a copy of Enemy_Vukah_Melee_Elite_Armored (health x2 comes from Necromancer at runtime). Earlier on the heavy skeleton knight, whose greatsword moves and own effects did not suit it.
